proposedContract.lifecycle: Supported compatibility storage via offline reviewed migration; no new HTTP CRUD, timer, runtime draft bridge or automatic legacy bot activation.
proposedContract.identity: merchant_id must resolve to the same tenant as the canonical conversation; customer_id is a candidate external sender identifier, not a trusted internal account ID. Map to customer_external_id only after equality with that conversation's external customer identity and channel ownership are validated. Do not derive authority from messenger-<customer> alone.
proposedContract.awaiting: Map only exact product or customer_info to awaiting_field unchanged, retaining the original payload. Unknown, conflicting or empty values block readiness; do not infer a new conversational state.
proposedContract.timestamps: started_at -> created_at and updated_at -> updated_at only with valid, ordered, source-bound instants; no migration NOW/defaultNow repair. Missing/invalid/inconsistent inputs block readiness.
proposedContract.expiry: Accept a validated explicit original expires_at, or derive it from the last valid old activity timestamp plus a proven effective old-reader TTL bound to the frozen source/configuration checkpoint. Require trusted cutoff time/provenance; an environment default/current TTL alone is not historical evidence. Never create a fresh deadline from migration time. If both expiry sources exist and disagree, block readiness.
proposedContract.expired: Preserve proven historical expiry in the mapped record; expired status never becomes active merely because data is imported. No expiry deletion, cleanup or retention duration is authorized.
proposedContract.duplicates: If canonical and transitional drafts describe the same target draft/conversation, require matching tenant/customer/state/time/payload provenance or stop with an explicit conflict. Do not silently replace canonical ownership/state based on input order.
proposedContract.failure: Any unsupported/ambiguous record makes the complete plan not write-ready. Return bounded diagnostic codes/record references without dumping draft PII to general logs. Preserve all source bytes; no silent row omission/quarantine destination/import side effect.
proposedContract.consumer: Mapped storage is not a supported automatic runtime continuation consumer. Any future continuation requires separately reviewed current tenant/channel/customer ownership, original expiry, product/price/stock validity and idempotent order rules before activation; this choice does not approve that feature.
proposedContract.sideEffects: No order creation, stock/payment mutation, outbound message, SQL permission grant, retention/hash rewrite or source-file mutation.

Incomplete/expired/unknown drafts are never silently discarded or made active. Missing real provenance may continue to block an actual migration.
